data.description: A moonbound werewolf in animal or hybrid form loses its damage reduction during a new moon. During this time, the moonbound werewolf also suffers -2 Strength and -2 Constitution in all forms, instead of the normal +2 bonuses. These changes decrease its CR by 1.
data.name: Moonbound (New Moon)
